name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages an Nginx multisite web server for three virtual hosts, including HTTPS, static content, security configuration, Fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl hardening, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, runtime directories, logging, SELinux-related dependencies, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python and PostgreSQL, including source checkout, virtual environment and requirements installation, database/user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
